technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish technicals (Ichimoku TK cross, new highs) offset by overbought conditions, weak intermediate trend structure, and bearish MACD histogram; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 17 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases by non-senior members) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (352.48), flat yield curve, and earnings in 17 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku TK cross-up, new 20-day highs, and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) offer short-term momentum entry with defined support at 284.04.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 17 days, crisis-level VIX, price below 200-EMA/50-SMA, negative MACD histogram, weak ADX trend strength, and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While Ichimoku TK cross and new 20-day highs offer short-term momentum, the risk/reward is severely compromised by earnings in 17 days, crisis-level VIX, and price below 200-EMA with negative MACD histogram.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 17 days combined with crisis VIX (352.48) and weak intermediate trend structure creates unacceptable volatility risk for swing trade execution.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 9 IT positions with existing ACN exposure; sector concentration and portfolio saturation further reduce conviction for marginal entry.
